definitions.gloss: outside rounds; visiting clients; outside sales
definitions.explanation: Going outside the office to visit clients, make deliveries, or conduct business at external locations. A common part of many sales and service jobs in Japan.
The outer circle of a loop line (such as the Yamanote Line in Tokyo) or the outer circumference of something.

examples.english: Today is a day for outside visits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外回|そとまわ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧⟦{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}った→歩き回る：04605_arukimawaru⟧。
examples.english: I walked around all day doing outside sales calls.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外回|そとまわ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{客先|きゃくさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}か→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Doing outside rounds on a rainy day is tough, but you have to arrive at the client's on time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山手線|やまのてせん}→山手線：30709_yamanotesen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外回|そとまわ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: To ride the outer loop of the Yamanote Line.

examples.japanese: {外回|そとまわ}り⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{内回|うちまわ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦{反対方向|はんたいほうこう}→反対方向：30278_hantaihoukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I mixed up the outer and inner loops and got on in the wrong direction.

examples.japanese: {外回|そとまわ}り⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦{右側|みぎがわ}→右側：24189_migigawa⟧です。
examples.english: The outer loop platform is on the right after going up the stairs.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is a common business term. Office workers who spend time visiting clients are said to be doing {外回|そとまわ}り, in contrast to ⟦{内勤|ないきん}→内勤：19695_naikin⟧ (office/desk work).

Sense 2 is used for circular train lines and tracks. On the Yamanote Line, {外回|そとまわ}り goes clockwise and {内回|うちまわ}り goes counterclockwise.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外回|そとまわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧ (outside sales)
- {外回|そとまわ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to go out on rounds)
- ⟦{山手線|やまのてせん}→山手線：30709_yamanotesen⟧{外回|そとまわ}り (Yamanote Line outer loop)
